query: ISO 2768 medium class general tolerance bore

results.title: ISO 2768-1:1989 General tolerances
results.content: General tolerances for linear and angular dimensions without individual tolerance indications. Tolerance class m (medium) applies a permissible deviation of 0.2 mm for nominal lengths over 30 up to 120 mm.

results.title: On the interpretation of general tolerance classes
results.content: We compare the deviation envelopes implied by ISO 2768 classes f, m, c and v across 412 machined features and report a systematic bias of 0.03 mm in class m.

results.title: Machining handbook: general tolerance selection
results.content: Class m is the default for general machining. Specify a tighter class only where function requires it, since class f roughly doubles inspection time.

results.title: Engineering tolerance
results.content: Engineering tolerance is the permissible limit of variation in a physical dimension.

results.title: How strictly is ISO 2768 m enforced in practice?
results.content: In my shop we treat class m as advisory for non-mating features, which is not what the standard says.
